title: Garbi 2
label: Sur Sagar
notes: Includes a 60:10 continuous Garbi 2 master plus 29 individually indexed component tracks. A circulating YouTube upload is not marked official until channel ownership is independently verified.
description: Garbi 2 is a 2025 Sur Sagar release by Hardik Dave and Rahul Munjariya. The catalogue includes a 60:10 continuous master alongside 29 individually indexed component tracks across Mataji devotional, traditional Garba, dakla, raas/dandiya and folk/lokgeet categories.
